2. Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate and Mr. Arjun Arora, 
Advocate holding brief of Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate 
for legal representatives of respondent no.1-Santram S/o 
Shri Sandal.
3. A supplementary affidavit has been filed by the State 
along with Miscellaneous Application. The same is taken 
on record. Miscellaneous Application (IA No.2 of 2025) is, 
therefore, allowed.
4. By means of the present writ petition, the 
petitioner/State has put to challenge the order dated 
05.05.2023 passed by the learned Board of Revenue, 
whereby, the application of the State for Restoration was 
rejected on the ground of its being barred by limitation 
and the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act 
has also been rejected.
6. Issue notice to the respondent no.2 returnable within 
four weeks. Steps to be taken within a week.
7. List this case on 18.12.2025.
8. It is contended by learned counsel appearing for the 
caveator that respondent no.1 Santram S/o Sandal has 
already expired and he is appearing for legal 
representatives of respondent no.1.
9. State may file an application for bringing on record 
the legal representative of Santram S/o Sandal in the 
present writ petition in between.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 03.11.2025
